name: VolMix
headline: Control one app’s sound.
单独调整一个应用的声音。
summary: Adjust volume and mute for detected audio apps from your Mac menu bar.
在 Mac 菜单栏中，为检测到的音频应用独立调音或静音。
features: Independent volume from 0% to 100%
0%–100% 独立音量调节
App mute and live audio indicators
应用静音与实时发声指示
System output selection in the same panel
在同一面板选择系统输出设备
limits: Requires system-audio capture permission. Protected audio and some routing or devices may not work. Controls apps, not browser tabs; no amplification above 100% or per-app output routing.
需要系统音频捕获权限。受保护音频、部分路由或设备可能不兼容。按应用而非浏览器标签页控制；不支持超过 100% 放大或按应用分配输出设备。

name: NetDoctor
headline: Understand your connection.
看清网络连接的问题。
summary: Inspect your Mac’s network state and get practical next steps without changing network settings.
检查 Mac 网络状态并获取排查建议，不修改网络设置。
features: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, DNS and route information
Wi-Fi、以太网、DNS 与路由信息
Internet reachability and local diagnostic history
互联网连通性与本地诊断时间线
Export a redacted support package yourself
主动导出脱敏支持包
limits: Read-only diagnostics, not automatic repair or a VPN service. Connectivity tests contact public endpoints. Results describe the sampled connection and do not guarantee that every service is reachable.
仅提供只读诊断，不是自动修复或 VPN 服务。连通性测试会访问公开端点；结果反映采样情况，不保证所有服务均可访问。

name: KSIC Studio
headline: Keep your work links together.
把工作入口放在一起。
summary: Organize, search and open your websites and work resources from a local-first Mac workspace.
在本地优先的 Mac 工作空间中整理、搜索和打开网站与工作资源。
features: Group and search your work links
分组整理和搜索工作链接
Open recent and featured links from the menu bar
从菜单栏打开最近和精选链接
Import configuration and back up your workspace
导入配置与备份工作空间
limits: Opens links in your default browser. HTTPS reachability checks run when requested. This is a link launcher, not a cloud sync or team collaboration service.
链接交给默认浏览器打开，HTTPS 连通性检查由用户主动发起。这是链接启动工具，不是云同步或团队协作服务。

name: IE Compat Bridge
headline: Run legacy business pages in modern Chrome.
在现代化 Chrome 中流畅运行传统企业办公系统。
summary: Run legacy business and intranet pages in modern Chrome without running a Windows virtual machine.
在现代化 Chrome 中流畅运行传统政企办公与内网页面，摆脱笨重的 Windows 虚拟机。
features: DOM & JavaScript shims for legacy web forms
针对传统表单与弹窗选择器的 DOM/JS 兼容补丁
Scoped per-domain rule matching
按域名精细化匹配兼容规则
Zero Windows VM required on macOS
在 macOS 上无需启动笨重的 Windows 虚拟机
limits: JavaScript & DOM compatibility helper for modern Chrome. Not an Internet Explorer engine; does not run ActiveX, VBScript, or COM controls.
现代 Chrome 的 JS 与 DOM 兼容补丁工具；非 IE 内核，不支持 ActiveX、VBScript 或 COM 控件。
